title: The forbidden state renders with a request-access control and refuses to surface a resource id, resource name or path shape
asA: authenticated operator without scope on a resource
iWant: the forbidden state to render with a request-access control routing to the applied notification centre and no resource-identifying content on the rendered surface
soThat: I have a legitimate recovery path and I cannot infer the existence of a resource I am not authorised to see

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a 403 response, the forbidden state renders inside role="region" with a keyboard-reachable [data-action="request-access"] control that POSTs to /api/request-access. The rendered surface does NOT contain any word matching the sensitive-pattern list (resource id shape, resource name shape, path-shape strings starting with /). The pack drives /probe/forbidden and reads the region, the control, and the full document text for pattern hits.

When the request-access POST returns a non-2xx or times out, the surface announces the failure via the polite live region, keeps the request-access control keyboard-reachable in a retry-able state (data-state=idle) and never shows a submitted-success state.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the forbidden state rendered and the request-access endpoint returns a non-2xx or times out
acceptanceCriteria.then: the polite live region announces the failure, data-state=idle is restored on the control and no data-state=submitted transition fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: The forbidden state never renders the resource identifier or any per-resource detail; the heading names the class ("You do not have access to this resource") and the explanation names the missing capability class only.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a forbidden state on any resource id
acceptanceCriteria.then: no resource identifier is present in the DOM, only the class name of the resource type and the missing capability class
